info.title: justbdd
info.description: Renders the CTRF files of several test projects (dotnet test --report-xunit-ctrf) into one Davish.JustBdd HTML report: justbdd html TestResults.

commands.name: html
commands.description: Render the CTRF files of several test projects into one HTML report.

options.name: --output
options.description: The HTML file to write. Defaults to justbdd.html in the first input's folder.

arguments.name: INPUTS
arguments.description: CTRF files, folders, or file name wildcards. A folder contributes its *.ctrf.json and *.ctrf files. Defaults to TestResults.
